chapter: WPA band and 1930s New Orleans bands
title: Reel 2: WPA band photo from the Italian Hall
summary: Interviewer opens reel 2 with a picture of the original WPA band, formerly Ray's band, made at the Italian Hall.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I've got some good trombone players over there. We're on Rheel 2 now, huh, Saladier. Now, you got this picture made at the Italian Hall? Yes, there, on Barrow Street.
And whose band is it? You know Joe Maxey? I know him, yes, I met him. Trombone, I know him. Well, this is the original WPA band, in fact it was the EO Ray band before the WPA.
